title: ChatGPT Is Now Regulated Like Google as a Search Engine in the EU
summary: ChatGPT Is Now Regulated Like Google as a Search Engine in the EU ChatGPT With Ad. © OpenAI Set Trending Topics as a preferred source on Google.
content: The European Commission has just placed three more services under the strictest tier of the Digital Services Act (DSA). ChatGPT will be treated as a Very Large Online Search Engine (VLOSE), while Reddit and Roblox are now designated Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs). All three services have reported that they reach at least 45 million average monthly users in the EU, the threshold at which the Commission takes over direct oversight. ... Once notified, the services have four months, until the end of December, to comply with the additional obligations for VLOPs and VLOSEs. At the core sits an annual assessment of the systemic risks stemming from the service itself and from its algorithmic systems: the spread of illegal content, negative effects on minors, consequences for users’ physical and mental wellbeing, and risks to fundamental rights, electoral processes and public security. Each assessment has to be followed by concrete mitigation measures, which independent auditors then review. ... -and-action mechanisms for illegal content along with complaint procedures, a crisis response mechanism, and, for platforms running recommender systems, at least one ... The designation also gives the Commission investigatory powers to assess how the services and any connected systems work. Oversight is shared with the national Digital Services Coordinators: Coimisiún na Meán for ChatGPT and Reddit, and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) for Roblox, since the services are established in Ireland and the Netherlands respectively. How seriously the Commission treats enforcement became visible in its recent proceedings against major porn platforms. ... For OpenAI, though, the biggest structural shift lies in the classification itself. An AI assistant is being regulated as a search engine for the first time, with everything that follows from it: traceable answer systems, research data access, and reporting channels for problematic content. That makes the decision a precedent for the entire market of AI chatbots, because it sets the reach at which a model provider in Europe is regulated like an infrastructure service. ... “These new designations mean that ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox will now be subject to a higher level of scrutiny and accountability in the European Union, commensurate with their significant impact on our citizens and society,” said Henna Virkkunen, Executive Vice-President for Tech Sovereignty, Security and Democracy. “We continue to monitor the digital landscape closely and will not hesitate to designate any platform that meets the threshold for enhanced supervision under the Digital Services Act.”

title: ChatGPT becomes first AI chatbot to face tougher EU rules

content: The AI chatbot ChatGPT and online platforms Reddit and Roblox will have to comply with tougher safety rules after the EU added them to a list of digital services subject to greater legal scrutiny. — AFP ... BRUSSELS: ChatGPT will have to comply with tougher safety rules after the EU added it on Aug 31 to a list of digital services subject to greater legal scrutiny in Europe, a first for an AI chatbot. ... Brussels also designated the Reddit forum and the popular gaming network Roblox as "very large" online platforms, a label that comes with additional obligations and oversight. ... "ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox will now be held to a higher standard of scrutiny and accountability in the European Union (EU), in line with their large impact on our citizens and society," EU technology chief Henna Virkkunen said. ... The "very large" designation applies to platforms and search engines with more than 45 million monthly active users in the 27-nation bloc, a threshold ChatGPT, Reddit and Roblox reported meeting, the commission said. ... The three now have four months to comply with additional obligations under the Digital Services Act (DSA), a content law that is a major weapon in the legal armoury the EU has deployed to rein in Big Tech in recent years. ... These include "assessing and mitigating" risks related to "the dissemination of illegal content, the negative effects on minors, users' physical and mental well-being, fundamental rights, electoral processes and public security," Brussels said. ... To bring it under the DSA's regulatory umbrella, the commission qualified ChatGPT as a search engine. ... Lena-Maria Boswald, of the German tech think tank Interface, said ahead ... the announcement that the expected move would set a " ... AI system used ... The widened scrutiny will also apply to Roblox, a US-based gaming platform popular with children and known for its immersive world of colourful graphics, and to the sprawling US discussion platform Reddit. ... The designations come as the EU has stepped up regulatory enforcement against the world's biggest digital platforms, including many American ones, despite strong US pushback and threats of retaliation. ... The EU has separately adopted the world's most far-reaching rules to govern artificial intelligence. The flagship AI Act entered into force in 2024, with obligations kicking in over several years to curb uses of the technology deemed too dangerous. ... Companies found in breach of the DSA face heavy penalties, including fines of up to six per cent of their annual global turnover and, in cases of serious and repeated violations, a possible ban on operating in Europe.

title: Anthropic Rumored to Prep 2 New Claude Models
summary: Anthropic Rumored to Prep 2 New Claude Models AI & Machine Learning Anthropic Rumored to Prep 2 New Claude Models [2026] Anthropic may be sitting on two unreleased Claude models at once, according to a growing thread of trade-press speculation that picked up steam this week.
content: Anthropic may be sitting on two unreleased Claude models at once, according to a growing thread of trade-press speculation that picked up steam this week. Neither model has been named or confirmed by Anthropic. But the pattern the rumor is built on is real: over the past 15 months, the company has repeatedly shipped major models in tight pairs rather than one at a time, and industry watchers say the conditions for another double release are lining up again as August 2026 closes out. ... The chatter, flagged by outlets including thewincentral.com and picked up in Seeking Alpha’s markets coverage, has not been confirmed by Anthropic PBC. The company has not announced specific model names, release dates, or specs for anything beyond what is already shipping. That absence of an official statement is itself part of the story: Anthropic has a track record of announcing new Claude models on the day they ship, with little or no pre-launch lead time, which is exactly why a “double release” rumor spreads faster than it can be verified. ... Opus 4.6 launched, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 followed just 12 days later, a gap short enough that CNBC’s coverage described it as the company’s second major model launch in less than two weeks. Before that, Claude Opus 4.5 had ... The rest of 2026 followed the same rhythm. Claude Opus 4.7 arrived in April, positioned publicly as a less risky alternative sitting below the newer Mythos-class tier. Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 followed in June, with Fable 5 landing June 9 as the first generally available model in the new Mythos class, a tier Anthropic now positions above Opus in raw capability. Claude Sonnet 5 shipped June 30, and Claude Opus 5 followed on July 24. That is five distinct model releases in under eight months. Against that backdrop, a rumor that two more models are already in the pipeline doesn’t require much of a leap. ... Nothing about two specific new Claude models is confirmed as of August 31, 2026. What is confirmed is a company that has shipped eight named models in roughly nine months, made a habit of pairing frontier and volume-tier releases, and just converted an introductory API price into a permanent one. That combination is exactly why a “double release” rumor is spreading now, and exactly why it should be read as a plausible extension of an established pattern rather than a confirmed event, until Anthropic says otherwise. ... No. As of August 31, 2026, Anthropic has not named, dated, or specified any unreleased models. The reports come from outlets including thewincentral.com and Seeking Alpha’s markets coverage, not from an Anthropic announcement.

title: DeepMind tests Gemini inside sealed evaluation system — Arabian Post
summary: DeepMind tests Gemini inside sealed evaluation system — Arabian Post 0 likes DeepMind tests Gemini inside sealed evaluation system 🕚 Sat 29 Aug 2026 · AP News Google DeepMind has completed what it describes as the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class artificia
content: DeepMind tests Gemini inside sealed evaluation system — Arabian Post ... DeepMind tests Gemini inside sealed evaluation system ... Google DeepMind has completed what it describes as the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class artificial intelligence model, testing Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite while preventing both the developer and external evaluators from accessing each other’s confidential material. ... DeepMind worked with the Singapore AI Safety Institute, independent evaluation organisation AVERI, privacy technology group OpenMined and benchmarking consortium MLCommons. The experiment placed Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite and confidential evaluation material inside a protected computing environment, allowing the model to process the questions without exposing them to Google and without revealing the model weights to the evaluators. ... Two evaluation exercises were conducted using Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite. AVERI used previously unreleased prompts drawn from the MLCommons AILuminate safety benchmark family, while the Singapore AI Safety Institute supplied a separate confidential prompt collection. MLCommons had deliberately reserved part of its benchmark so that the material had not previously been exposed to the model being tested. ... The double-blind architecture attempts to protect both interests simultaneously. Evaluators can examine a proprietary system without receiving its underlying weights, while developers can submit a model for independent assessment without acquiring the confidential questions against which it is being measured. The arrangement could become particularly important for cybersecurity, biological-risk and government evaluations involving data too sensitive to exchange through conventional testing procedures. ... The experiment builds on earlier work involving confidential computing and AI testing. OpenMined said a 2024 project involving Anthropic and the UK AI Safety Institute explored double-blind evaluation techniques using public assets, including GPT-2 and part of a biological dataset. The new exercise differs by placing genuinely proprietary model material and unreleased evaluation data inside the protected system.
